title: Lanthanoid-Peroxo-Komplexe mit μ3-η2:η2:η2-(O2^2−)-Koordination. Die Kristallstrukturen von [Ln4(O2)2Cl8(Py)10]·Py mit Ln = Sm, Eu, Gd

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear lanthanoid peroxo chloride pyridine cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to the Gd compound (3·py), described as the exemplar synthesis. Anhydrous SmCl3 (obtained from Sm2O3 by the ammonium chloride method) is dissolved with warming in pyridine, diacetone alcohol (4-hydroxy-4-methyl-2-pentanone) is added, and the solution is heated at reflux for about 5 min with admission of air. After cooling, any undissolved residue is filtered off and the open vessel is left at room temperature for several days, giving pale yellow single crystals of 1·py, which are isolated by decanting, washing with a little pentane, and brief drying in vacuum. Moisture exclusion is required for the manipulations; air oxygen is the peroxide source.

synthesis.procedure: Moisture-free conditions. Anhydrous GdCl3 (from Gd2O3 by the ammonium chloride method) is used. Dissolve 50 mg GdCl3 (0.19 mmol) with warming in 5 ml pyridine, add 2 ml diacetone alcohol, and heat the solution at reflux for about 5 min with admission of air. Under the pyridine excess, hydrolytic decomposition does not occur. After cooling, filter any small amount of undissolved material and leave the mixture in an open vessel at room temperature for several days. Well-formed single crystals of 3·py deposit on the glass wall and are isolated by decanting the supernatant, washing with a little pentane, and brief drying in vacuum. Yield about 20% based on GdCl3. Elemental analysis for C55H55N11Cl8O4Gd: C 34.80 (calcd. 35.77); H 3.00 (3.04); N 8.19 (8.34)%. IR and Raman spectra of the Gd compound are reported as vibrational characterization.
